focus: The most useful competition is against yesterday's version of the organization or person, because WHY is measured by fidelity rather than category dominance. A reader learns to use rivals as information without letting them define the purpose.
coreClaim: The New Competition turns self-referenced competition into a practical decision rule backed by named cases and checkable details.

centralConcept.name: self-referenced competition
centralConcept.plainDefinition: The most useful competition is against yesterday's version of the organization or person, because WHY is measured by fidelity rather than category dominance.
centralConcept.whyItMatters: A reader learns to use rivals as information without letting them define the purpose.

keyClaims: self-referenced competition becomes usable only when tied to visible behavior.
Apple and Dell contrast gives the first concrete anchor.
Microsoft long-run rivalry creates contrast so the idea is not one anecdote.
Southwest Airlines operating benchmark adds a boundary case for application.
External rival, Internal benchmark, Purpose fidelity, Continuous improvement keep the unit from collapsing into generic purpose talk.

namedExamples.label: Apple and Dell contrast
namedExamples.summary: Apple Inc. and Dell make the external-rival contrast concrete through the 2001 iPod and 2003 Dell DJ.

hardEdge: The tempting misread is to turn self-referenced competition into a universal slogan and ignore the cases. The stricter reading keeps the claim tied to the specific examples and uses the framework only where the details support it.

testableFacts.claim: Apple and Dell contrast makes self-referenced competition concrete through Apple Inc. and Dell.
testableFacts.becauseMechanism: Because Apple Inc. gives the idea a visible setting, the reader can test the claim against behavior instead of accepting a slogan.
testableFacts.commonError: The safe move is to treat Apple and Dell contrast as colorful background.
testableFacts.errorIsWhy: The case carries the mechanism, so treating it as decoration removes the lesson's evidence.

testableFacts.claim: Microsoft long-run rivalry adds a second anchor for self-referenced competition with Microsoft and 1975 founding.
testableFacts.becauseMechanism: Since a second case repeats the pattern in a different venue, the mechanism is less likely to be a one-off anecdote.
testableFacts.commonError: One example is enough to prove the whole model.
testableFacts.errorIsWhy: One example can illustrate; comparison is what exposes the transferable pattern.

testableFacts.claim: Southwest Airlines operating benchmark supplies a third checkable scene using Southwest Airlines and 1971.
testableFacts.becauseMechanism: Because the third scene changes the cast and setting, the writer can vary examples without inventing a new case.
testableFacts.commonError: A third case should simply repeat the first case's lesson.
testableFacts.errorIsWhy: The third case should test a neighboring misconception, not restamp the same sentence.

testableFacts.claim: self-referenced competition depends on the sequence External rival before Internal benchmark.
testableFacts.becauseMechanism: Because the first term frames the second, reversing them makes the visible tactic carry a job it cannot carry alone.
testableFacts.commonError: Order is stylistic, so any sequence works if the message sounds polished.
testableFacts.errorIsWhy: Order changes diagnosis; a polished tactic cannot repair a wrong premise.

testableFacts.claim: External rival, Internal benchmark, Purpose fidelity, Continuous improvement form the local framework for The New Competition.
testableFacts.becauseMechanism: Because each member names a different job, the writer can assign claims to distinct functions rather than blending them.
testableFacts.commonError: The framework is a slogan and can be shortened to one word.
testableFacts.errorIsWhy: Shortening removes the distinctions the quiz and examples need to test.

testableFacts.claim: 2001 iPod is a hard detail that should stay attached to Apple and Dell contrast.
testableFacts.becauseMechanism: Because hard specifics are portable only inside their case, moving 2001 iPod to another example creates false grounding.
testableFacts.commonError: Any true detail can be reused wherever it sounds useful.
testableFacts.errorIsWhy: A true detail becomes misleading when it is attached to the wrong case.

testableFacts.claim: software company gives Microsoft long-run rivalry a different factual token from Apple and Dell contrast.
testableFacts.becauseMechanism: Since the factual token is different, comparison can teach contrast rather than repeating a generic success story.
testableFacts.commonError: All business examples can use the same date-place-scale language.
testableFacts.errorIsWhy: Generic stamping makes real cases feel invented and blurs the chapter-specific spine.

testableFacts.claim: Dallas helps mark the boundary of self-referenced competition.
testableFacts.becauseMechanism: Because boundary details tell the reader where the idea stops, they prevent overgeneralizing from a single attractive case.
testableFacts.commonError: A useful concept should apply the same way to every named organization.
testableFacts.errorIsWhy: The mechanism changes by venue; boundary details keep the application honest.

testableFacts.claim: The New Competition should teach self-referenced competition through Apple and Dell contrast, Microsoft long-run rivalry, and Southwest Airlines operating benchmark, not through generic leadership advice.
testableFacts.becauseMechanism: Because three named anchors carry separate hard specifics, the unit can make a testable claim without inventing scenes.
testableFacts.commonError: Purpose language alone is enough to ground a leadership lesson.
testableFacts.errorIsWhy: Purpose language without checkable anchors becomes motivational abstraction.
